name: Web app (React)
summary: A standalone React 19 single-page app with Vite 8 and TypeScript 6: TanStack Router and Query, Tailwind 4, a typed API client generated from an OpenAPI contract, cookie-session sign-in through a gateway (the browser never holds a token, CSRF-protected), and a worked items feature with optimistic updates, accessible dialogs, dark mode and a strict CSP. Its dev server includes a mock gateway, so it runs with no backend. Vitest with axe, Playwright at 1280 and 390, a hardened non-root nginx image.
features: BFF sign-in (no tokens in the browser), CSRF header, strict CSP, runtime /config.json
Typed client, query options and zod schemas generated from openapi.json, checked in CI
Items CRUD: optimistic updates, keyboard and screen-reader friendly, 85% coverage, axe, Playwright

toolchain.installHint: Install Node.js 24 LTS from https://nodejs.org/. Docker is optional: it runs the checks and the browser suite in pinned images, and builds the production image.
